entries.what: Grace spent the early morning researching grab rails after Nanay's slip on the back step on Nov 2, then drove to the hardware store and installed one herself before school instead of waiting for Ramón's day off. Nanay now uses a cane.
entries.outcome: Grab rail installed on the back step; Corazón uses a cane.

entries.what: Taught periods 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 at Flats High and ate leftover rice and ulam in B12 during prep, lunching with Dana.
entries.outcome: Got through a full day of bonding lessons on little sleep.

entries.what: Evening at home: watched the teleserye with Corazón and checked that she could manage the cane around the house.
entries.outcome: Nanay insisted she was fine; Grace kept watching her on the steps.

entries.what: Election day: Grace voted yes on Measure K at the Vinca Avenue Community Center after school, then taught her usual classes.
entries.outcome: Cast her ballot on the way home.

entries.what: Ran a Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session in B12 and graded Unit 3 quizzes at her desk.
entries.outcome: Cleared a small stack of makeup labs.

entries.what: Dinner with Isabel and Corazón; Isabel and Grace traded sarcastic remarks over essay drafts.
entries.outcome: Dinner ended with Isabel retreating to her room.

entries.what: Taught all day and picked up Nanay's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore after school, as it was her every-other-Wednesday run.
entries.outcome: Prescriptions collected and pill organizer refilled that night.

entries.what: Late evening, Grace refilled Corazón's pill organizer quietly at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Organizer ready for the week.

entries.what: Graded Unit 3 labs and entered scores in the gradebook before bed.
entries.outcome: Gradebook current.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk at 5:45 a.m. with Dana, their Thursday routine.
entries.outcome: Dana vented about her evaluations; Grace felt clearer.

entries.what: Taught all five sections, lunched in B12 with Dana, and ran Eli's extended-time test during prep.
entries.outcome: Eli finished his test undisturbed.

entries.what: Evening at home preparing the Unit 3 moles review and helping Corazón with dinner.
entries.outcome: Review set ready for Monday.

entries.what: Taught all day and submitted the Friday form at 3:30 using her spreadsheet template.
entries.outcome: Absence report sent on time.

entries.what: Isabel and her friends attended opening night of the Flats High fall play at the Ortega Playhouse; Grace dropped them off and went home to rest.
entries.outcome: Quiet house for the evening.

entries.what: Evening with Nanay watching her show; Ramón was on his dispatch shift.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Saturday groceries at Ruiz Family Market and conchas from Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: Pantry stocked; bought a soft roll for Nanay.

entries.what: Afternoon in the backyard tending calamansi pots and checking that the new grab rail was solid.
entries.outcome: Ramón tightened the rail bolts.

entries.what: Picked Isabel up from the play afterparty and talked about the college list in the car.
entries.outcome: Agreed to look at numbers together Sunday.

entries.what: Tagalog Mass at 9 at Our Lady of the Marsh with Corazón, who walked in with her cane, then a sinigang lunch.
entries.outcome: Lunch with the family.

entries.what: Grace ran three net-price estimates herself at the kitchen table, then asked the assistant for a month-by-month cash projection through 2030 before raising the cap.
entries.outcome: Cap raised to $32,000 net, conditional on a campus job.

entries.what: Told Isabel about the new cap and the campus job condition after dinner.
entries.outcome: Isabel was stunned and thanked her; Ramón smiled quietly.

entries.what: Graded Unit 3 papers at the kitchen table in the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Finished most of the stack.
